content.about: Kiribati is a Pacific nation of 33 islands across the equator. Its islands are low atolls. It is one of the first places to see each new day. Phoenix Islands is a huge protected area.

standout.text: Kiritimati is one of the largest coral atolls by land area.

didYouKnow: It is among the first to see the New Year.
Phoenix Islands is a large marine reserve.
